notes: Cliopatria's two Sosso shapes (1202-1226, 1227-1235) are the Ghana shape and are used here only as the Wagadu part; the Sosso heartland around Boron/Koulikoro lies outside them and is added in the keyframe corrections. Open points: (1) the Sosso's origin as a 'clan of slaves of the Kaya Magha' and the Diarra/Kemoko Kante dynasty are given without dates; the page itself says there 'is in fact no evidence that Diarra had any connection to Soumaoro Kante'. (2) The year of the Manden conquest is a bridge (confidence 1). (3) Sosso ends 1235 (Cliopatria) but Mali starts 1236 (Cliopatria): the Mali dossier dates its gain of the Sosso lands to 1236. (4) Soumaba Cisse of Ghana was a vassal of Soumaoro 1203-1235 (Ghana page's king list); the Ghana lands are drawn as direct Sosso territory. (5) Gajaaga, Diarra, Dialonkadugu and the Bure goldfields are named as conquests without dates and are not mapped. (6) Names missing from the gazetteer: none (Koulikoro and Kangaba resolve).
